notes: This PMID is a narrative REVIEW article ('In this review, we summarize the developments...'); it contains no Methods section and no primary experiments by these authors. Every dose, half-life and efficacy value above is a secondary citation summarised from other publications, so group sizes, routes, matrices, bioanalytical methods and error terms are almost entirely absent from the body. The PeplLife2 metadata lists HM15136 (54.5 h and 32.3 h, mouse serum, modified ELISA/ELISA), Compound 14, Compound 15 and Liraglutide half-lives; NONE of those numeric values appear in the body. The only HM15136 half-life stated in the body is '36 hr' with no species, matrix or assay given, and the body never mentions 'Compound 14'/'Compound 15' (it discusses a differently described 'peptide 14' exendin-4/Gcg dual agonist with no half-life value). The HM15136 sequence in Table 1 (HXQGTFTSDYSKYLDERRAKEFVQWLMNTC) lacks the Fc fragment extension listed in the metadata. Additional agents mentioned in the body but without dose/PK data and therefore not itemised above include: MK-0893, TH-Glucagon, [desHis1]glucagon, [dTyr10]glucagon, [dGlu20]glucagon, [Aib2]glucagon, [Aib2,His3]glucagon, [dPhe4]glucagon (0.5 ug administered, rat), [dPhe4,Phe25,Leu27]glucagon-amide, [dSer2,dPhe4,Phe25,Leu27]glucagon-amide, oxyntomodulin, OXMQ3E, SAR425899, efinopegdutide, mazdutide, BI 456906, NNC9204-1777, pemvidutide, HM15211, SAR441255, tirzepatide and dulaglutide.
